title: Phenol/Chloroform Genomic DNA Extraction Protocol
author: Daniel J. Richter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.inzcdf6
materials: In hood, shake vigorously to mix.
Precipitate several hours, or overnight at -20º C.

steps.title: Initial Cell Pelleting
steps.instruction: Spin cells down in a 50 mL conical tube at maximum speed for 20 minutes at 4º C.

steps.title: Cell Lysis
steps.instruction: Lyse the cell pellet using lysis buffer and mechanical shearing.

substeps.instruction: Add lysis buffer in multiples of 700 μL per pellet (e.g., 1.4 mL, 2.1 mL) depending on pellet volume.
Pass the sample through a 1 mL or 5 mL syringe fitted with a 21 gauge needle twenty times.

steps.title: Removal of Unlysed Material
steps.instruction: Spin the sample again for 20 minutes at maximum speed at 4º C to pellet unlysed cellular material.

steps.title: RNA Digestion
steps.instruction: Treat the supernatant with RNAse A to remove RNA.

substeps.instruction: Split the supernatant from each conical tube into 700 μL aliquots in 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes (retain unlysed pellets if desired).
Add 3.5 μL RNAse A (4 mg/ml, final concentration 20 ng/μl) per tube.
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature on a nutator.
Incubate at 50º C for 3 hours, swirling occasionally.

steps.title: Protein Digestion
steps.instruction: Treat the sample with Proteinase K.

substeps.instruction: Add 7 μL of Proteinase K (10 mg/mL, final concentration of 100 ng/μL).
Cool the sample to room temperature.

steps.title: Phenol-Chloroform Extraction
steps.instruction: Perform phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol extraction in a chemical hood to remove proteins.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 μL of phenol:chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (pH 8.0) per tube.
Spin for 10 minutes at maximum speed at room temperature.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase into a new tube.
Repeat this extraction process 3-4 times until no protein remains at the interphase.

steps.title: Chloroform-Isoamyl Alcohol Wash
steps.instruction: Perform a final wash to remove residual phenol.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume of chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (no phenol) and shake vigorously to mix.
Spin for 10 minutes at maximum speed at room temperature.
Remove the upper aqueous phase and combine into a single tube (1.5 mL Eppendorf or 15 mL conical) with room for 3X the sample volume.

steps.title: DNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate the genomic DNA using ammonium acetate, GlycoBlue, and ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 1/20 of the volume of 10 M ammonium acetate (final concentration 0.5 M).
Add 1/3 μL of GlycoBlue (15 mg/mL, final concentration 50 ng/μL) per 100 μL of aqueous phase.
Add 2x the volume of 100% EtOH.
Spin at maximum speed at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Pour off the supernatant.

steps.title: 100% Ethanol Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet with 100% ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL (for 1.5 mL tube) or 10 mL (for 15 mL tube) of 100% EtOH.
Wash on a nutator for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Spin for 5-20 minutes at maximum speed.
Repeat for a total of 2-3 washes, pouring off the supernatant after each.

steps.title: 70% Ethanol Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA pellet with 70% ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL (for 1.5 mL tube) or 10 mL (for 15 mL tube) of 70% EtOH.
Wash on a nutator for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Spin for 5-20 minutes at maximum speed.
Remove supernatant and repeat for a total of 2-3 washes.

steps.title: Drying and Resuspension
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet and resuspend the DNA.

substeps.instruction: Dry the pellet for 5-10 minutes (do not over dry).
Re-suspend overnight in a small volume (~50-500 μL) of DNAse-free water.
